name: Frisbee 🥏
desc:
🥏 Frisbee

Jump into fast-paced, competitive Ultimate-style frisbee built for quick games, clutch plays, and clean mechanics. Whether you’re tossing dimes, skying defenders, or locking down on defense, every point is pure action. The game is currently in early beta, so you may encounter bugs—but the core gameplay is live and ready to compete.

👍 Like & Favorite to support development and future updates
⚡ Join the College Football Group to take part in leagues, events, and organized matches
❌ Report bugs or feedback in our Social Server — your input directly shapes the game’s future
